title: Tool
description: An executable mechanism available to an Agent (CR-7 §30): CRM/ERP APIs, search, databases, workflow engines, payment services, code execution, knowledge graphs. Tool ≠ Service (§31): a Service exposes enterprise capability for consumption; a Tool is an invocable mechanism. They may overlap operationally but are semantically distinct.

id.description: Stable OpenDEA identifier (CR-3Q). Type prefix: dea:tool-

external_references.description: CR-3P: identifiers in external systems. Never a substitute for the OpenDEA id (E004).

endpoint_ref.description: The service/API the tool invokes, where applicable.

relationships.description: Derived convenience view (CR-1/CR-3): canonical relationship instances are authoritative.
